title: 745. Delete and Earn

examples.explanation: Three 3s beat any mix involving 2s or 4.

hints: Group equal values: taking v earns v times its frequency, and values sort into independent chains broken by gaps.
Within a chain of consecutive values this is the house-robber choice: take v plus the best up to v-2, or skip to the best up to v-1.
Track only two rolling best values while sweeping v upward.
